purpose: Machine-readable operating contract for agents working on the Digitize Germany mission.

mustApprove: changes to mission outcome or north star
adverse or legally consequential automated action
public claims that imply production, legal or government validation
architecture changes that centralize source-of-truth data
mayDelegate: open a review request when a gate is reached

can: decompose a life event into actors, evidence, rules, actions and exceptions
cannot: delete legally required steps without evidence

can: map needs to existing German rails
implement reversible prototypes, adapters, fixtures and UI
cannot: enable production writes or real personal data by default
convert modeled results into real-world impact claims

can: check evidence provenance, authority, minimisation, consent and fail-closed behavior
block a case when contract invariants fail
prepare proof packs, changelogs and next-step recommendations
mark reference tests passed when evidence is present
cannot: mark national or production readiness from prototype evidence

workflow: stop if a humanAuthority.mustApprove condition is hit
update nextMove or open human decision
invariants: Model confidence is not legal authority.
A citizen should not be asked to re-submit retrievable authoritative evidence without a documented reason.
Source-of-truth data remains with authoritative systems unless a justified bounded workflow copy is required.
Every automated external action identifies its authority and approval state.
Modeled proof must be labeled modeled until measured in a real service.

writeProtocol.preferred: Agents propose changes through version-controlled mission/evidence files and reviewable commits or pull requests.
writeProtocol.note: The public GitHub Pages UI is a read surface. Repository commits are the durable write surface, making agent changes reviewable and auditable.
